name: H.P. Lockecraft
creator: deepd0wn
description:
# H. P. Lockecraft

A fitting recolor of Locke - inspired by the Grandfather of Cosmic Horror. 

The skin attempts to use visuals inspired by The Call of Cthulhu and Color Out of Space - two of my favorite works - such as the totem from Call of Cthulhu and the mysterious and hypnotizing hues of the "color" from "Color Out of Space"

Features:

- Cosmic horror themed VFX on all attacks/abilities and animations
- H.P. featured loadscreen art and in game icon
- Meticulously retouched weapon, character and totem model

This was a ton of fun to make, I hope you enjoy!
